name: concert-agenda-mcp
description: MCP server that scrapes Dutch/Belgian metal concert agendas (zwaremetalen.com, metalfan.nl, metalagenda.nl) and exposes them as queryable tools. Built as a companion to the mcp-server-tmdb concierge: TMDB handles films, this handles gigs, so the curator protocol never has to guess whether a source is reachable.
